findings.new_evidence: A separate public English digital witness now confirms that this named interpretation is represented in an English Qurtubi rendering, rather than establishing that the stored English row contains it.
findings.boundary: The live English record omits this later item. QuranHub displays a corresponding translation, but this page exposes no verified translator, print edition, or source manifest sufficient to link its text to row 38030.
findings.attribution: The Arabic and parallel English witness frame Ikrimah as the named authority for the view; they do not provide an oral transmission chain in this clause.
findings.decision: Record a coverage/provenance discrepancy only. Do not call the stored row mistranslated, insert text, infer the missing route, or substitute QuranHub text without independent human review.
